cards_resequenced.change: authored by TRIAGE under R-087. When you answer a question from your phone, the system files that answer under a number it works out for itself instead of taking the next one from the shared list that everything else now uses. Two decisions can end up with the same number, and worse, the published change carrying your own answer fails its own checks and cannot go out. This makes the phone answers use the same list as everybody else.

authored by TRIAGE under R-088. The rulebook the reviewing role follows still describes the old way of numbering decisions, which was replaced yesterday. A session that follows its own rulebook now produces work that fails the automatic checks. This run had to ignore its own rulebook to be correct, which is how the gap was found.

authored by TRIAGE under R-089. This switches it on and adds a check so the next unowned one cannot sit there quietly.

authored by TRIAGE under R-090. The overnight system picks the next job by sorting job numbers as text, so job 16 comes out ahead of job 8. Two jobs from last week are stuck behind three newer ones and will stay there for ever. One of the two stuck jobs is the fix for the night that ran nine hours instead of forty-five minutes.

notes only, nothing changed and no dependency touched. Two more copies of the same hardcoded list of work boards were found outside the area this job already covers, recorded on it so the job is done once rather than twice.

NOT edited, deliberately. Every dependency between them was re-derived and each is correct as it stands. The chain waits on one person outside the project and that is escalated below rather than worked around by deleting an edge somebody put there on purpose.

escalations.title: The whole remaining tail of the current phase waits on one person outside the project, and nothing has moved for a week. Andre owes two things: confirmation that the document-reading contract is final, and one real supplier document run through his side of it. Everything after that is ours and is already built.
escalations.recommendation: Send Andre the two-line ask this week and set a date by which you will decide without him. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE THE WAIT IS NOW THE LONGEST THING ON THE BOARD AND THE COST IS INVISIBLE: the credential lock-down waits on his round trip, the client sign-off waits on the lock-down, and the last readiness condition waits on the sign-off. Three items and one readiness condition are parked behind one email. THE ALTERNATIVE, IF HE STAYS SILENT: rule that the credential lock-down may go ahead without his live round trip, and let the round trip land afterwards as its own job. That is your call and not a terminal's, because it changes what is asked of him. NOTHING WAS EDITED ON YOUR BEHALF: the ordering that makes the lock-down wait for him was put there deliberately, so that real client passwords are not rotated before the reading path has been proved once against the real supplier. IF UNANSWERED: nothing breaks and nothing gets worse. The system stays exactly as it is, with the automatic document reading proved against our own test documents and never once against his, and the phase cannot be closed.

escalations.title: Two settings in the live hosting environment for the low-stock warning email were first recorded on 2026-08-26, were put in front of you on 2026-08-31, and are still not set. Setting them is two clicks and it does not, on its own, make the warning email work.
escalations.recommendation: Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM in the PRODUCTION environment now, by name only, and reply that they are set. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE THEY COST NOTHING AND THEY ARE ON THE CRITICAL PATH ANYWAY: both are already required items on the credential lock-down list, so doing them now removes two items from that day rather than adding any. THE HONEST CAVEAT, REPEATED SO YOU ARE NOT SURPRISED LATER: this does NOT make that readiness condition pass. A third thing is needed, a recipient address that is not on a domain that does not exist, and that one lands with the real staff accounts at the lock-down. THIS IS THE SECOND TIME OF ASKING AND IT WILL KEEP APPEARING: an unanswered question is the one thing here that must never go quiet. IF UNANSWERED: nothing breaks. The warning email keeps recording its reason on screen and not sending, which is the designed behaviour, and both settings simply wait to be done on lock-down day instead.
